Develop industrial monitoring and reporting dashboards using Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and Tailwind CSS. Build IoT telemetry pipelines, PLC gateways, and maintenance management platforms.

Core Responsibilities & Achievements

  • Develop industrial monitoring and reporting dashboards using Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and Tailwind CSS.
  • Developed the full Angular Gateway application for communication and control of IoT and PLC devices.
  • Worked on MQTT-to-ThingsBoard data flows using Node-RED and REST APIs to ingest, retrieve and visualize real-time telemetry.

  • Contributed to dashboards for CMMP (Compressor Monitoring), Energy Meter, Flow Meter, Carbon Emission, and Generator Efficiency systems.

  • Designed multi-screen enterprise dashboards for a global consumer-goods client.
  • Worked on dashboards for the LADWP project; developed dashboards for the Gaugap agritech project.
  • Researched competitor CMMS platforms (ClickMaint) to guide UX and feature improvements.
  • Collaborated with iCenter modules to integrate data and enhance dashboard interactions.
  • Built a custom Markdown editor with rich-text formatting.
